metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
detects the use of wdigest
wdigest is insecure and should not be used
properties.query:
//wdigest is insecure and should not be used
let Suspicious_WDigest_Authentication = 
SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4624, 4776)
| extend AuthPackage = case(
     EventID == 4624, AuthenticationPackageName,
     EventID == 4776, PackageName,
    ""
)
| where AuthPackage =="WDigest";
let Suspicious_WDigest_registry_key_changes =
_Im_ProcessCreate
| where CommandLine has_any (dynamic(["reg add", "REG ADD", "REG.EXE ADD", "reg.exe add"]))
| where CommandLine contains @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest"
| where CommandLine has "UseLogonCredential" 
| where CommandLine has "/t Reg_DWORD"
| where CommandLine has "/d 1";
union isfuzzy=true
Suspicious_WDigest_Authentication, Suspicious_WDigest_registry_key_changes
| extend
    Computer = tostring(coalesce(
        column_ifexists("Computer", ""),
        column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")
    )),
    Account = tostring(coalesce(
        column_ifexists("TargetUserName", ""),
        column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")
    )),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", ""))
